newsitem.title: FINLAND: Baltic Ice - Most of Gulf of Finland ice-free.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Ice - Most of Gulf of Finland ice-free.

text.p: The Gulf of Finland became almost ice-free but there was still ridged ice up to 35 centimetres thick in the east outside St Petersburg and Vyborg, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said on Thursday.
The institute said in in its twice-weekly ice report that ice levels in the Gulf of Bothnia also continued to ease but all remaining Finnish and Swedish restrictions were unchanged.

Five ice-breakers were assisting in the northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia and one in the middle outside Kokkola and Pietarsaari, the institute said. Three ice-breakers were in action near St Petersburg in the eastern Gulf of Finland. (Temperatures of nearby isotherms, degrees Celsius)
